WITH samples AS ( SELECT day, loss
, upload, download, upload_ack, download_ack, seeding, downloading, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day ORDER BY loss, user_id) AS position, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS sample_count
FROM user_traffic_daily WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{through} ), totals AS ( SELECT day
, SUM(upload) AS upload, SUM(download) AS download, SUM(upload_ack) AS upload_ack, SUM(download_ack) AS download_ack, SUM(seeding) AS seeding, SUM(downloading) AS downloading, ROUND(AVG(loss) FILTER (WHERE retained)) AS average_loss, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(100 * loss / NULLIF(upload, 0), 0)) FILTER (WHERE retained), 8) AS loss_ratio
, SUM(loss) AS total_loss FROM samples
CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT position > sample_count / 100 AND position <= sample_count - sample_count / 100 AS retained ) trim
GROUP BY day ) SELECT days.day::date::text AS day
, COALESCE(upload, 0)::text AS upload, COALESCE(download, 0)::text AS download, COALESCE(upload_ack, 0)::text AS "uploadAck", COALESCE(download_ack, 0)::text AS "downloadAck", COALESCE(seeding, 0)::text AS seeding, COALESCE(downloading, 0)::text AS downloading, COALESCE(average_loss, 0)::text AS "averageLoss", COALESCE(loss_ratio, 0)::text AS "lossRatio"
, COALESCE(total_loss, 0)::text AS "totalLoss" FROM generate_series((SELECT MIN(day) FROM totals)::timestamp, CAST(#{through} AS timestamp), INTERVAL '1 day') AS days(day) LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.day = days.day::date ORDER BY days.day
